mapper.select: SELECT c.client_id,c.name,c.client_type,c.client_kind,c.resource,c.redirect_uris,c.scopes,c.status,c.create_time,c.can_introspect_api_keys,c.skip_consent,c.platform_id,p.name AS platform_name FROM t_oauth_clients c LEFT JOIN t_platforms p ON p.id=c.platform_id WHERE c.created_by=#{owner} AND c.is_deleted=0 AND (c.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.client_id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.resource LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.redirect_uris LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.scopes LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND c.client_kind=#{clientKind} AND c.status=#{status} ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_oauth_clients WHERE created_by=#{owner} AND is_deleted=0 AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR client_id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR resource LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR redirect_uris LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR scopes LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND client_kind=#{clientKind} AND status=#{status}

SELECT c.client_id,c.name,c.client_type,c.client_kind,c.resource,c.redirect_uris,c.scopes,c.status,c.create_time,c.can_introspect_api_keys,c.skip_consent,c.platform_id,p.name AS platform_name FROM t_oauth_clients c LEFT JOIN t_platforms p ON p.id=c.platform_id WHERE c.client_id=#{clientId} AND c.created_by=#{owner} AND c.is_deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE t_oauth_clients SET platform_id=#{platformId},name=#{name},resource=#{resource},redirect_uris=#{redirectUris},scopes=#{scopes},can_introspect_api_keys=#{canIntrospect},skip_consent=#{skipConsent} WHERE client_id=#{clientId} AND created_by=#{owner} AND is_deleted=0
UPDATE t_oauth_clients SET status=#{status} WHERE client_id=#{clientId} AND created_by=#{owner} AND is_deleted=0
UPDATE t_oauth_clients SET status='DELETED',is_deleted=1 WHERE client_id=#{clientId} AND created_by=#{owner} AND is_deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT name,apply_reason,audience FROM t_user_api_keys WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='APPROVED'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_api_keys SET key_hash=#{keyHash},key_prefix=#{prefix},status='ACTIVE' WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='APPROVED'
mapper.select: SELECT id,name,key_prefix,status,create_time,last_used_at,apply_reason,reviewed_at,review_comment,audience FROM t_user_api_keys WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT k.id,k.user_id,k.name,k.apply_reason,k.key_prefix,k.audience,k.status,k.create_time,k.last_used_at,k.reviewed_at,k.review_comment,k.validation_count,u.username,u.full_name,u.email,r.full_name AS reviewer_name FROM t_user_api_keys k LEFT JOIN t_users u ON u.id=k.user_id LEFT JOIN t_users r ON r.id=k.reviewed_by k.status IN ('PENDING','APPROVED','REJECTED')k.status IN ('ACTIVE','REVOKED')k.status=#{status}AND (k.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR k.audience LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR u.full_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR k.apply_reason LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY CASE k.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,k.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user_api_keys k LEFT JOIN t_users u ON u.id=k.user_id k.status IN ('PENDING','APPROVED','REJECTED')k.status IN ('ACTIVE','REVOKED')k.status=#{status}AND (k.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR k.audience LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR u.full_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR k.apply_reason LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_api_keys SET validation_count=validation_count+1,last_used_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE t_user_api_keys SET status=#{status},reviewed_by=#{reviewer},reviewed_at=NOW(),review_comment=#{comment} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE t_user_api_keys SET status='REVOKED',revoked_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE t_user_api_keys SET status='REVOKED',revoked_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT t.id,t.client_id,c.name AS client_name,t.token_type,t.scope,t.expires_at,t.create_time,t.revoked FROM t_oauth_tokens t LEFT JOIN t_oauth_clients c ON c.client_id=t.client_id WHERE t.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY t.id DESC
SELECT id,parent_id,token_type FROM t_oauth_tokens WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_oauth_tokens SET revoked=1 WHERE id=#{id} OR parent_id=#{id}
UPDATE t_oauth_tokens SET revoked=1 WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_oauth_authorization_codes WHERE code_hash=#{codeHash} AND client_id=#{clientId} AND redirect_uri=#{redirectUri}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_oauth_authorization_codes SET used=1 WHERE id=#{id} AND used=0 AND expires_at>NOW()
UPDATE t_oauth_tokens SET revoked=1 WHERE id=#{id} AND revoked=0 AND expires_at>NOW()
UPDATE t_oauth_tokens SET revoked=1 WHERE parent_id=#{parentId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_oauth_tokens WHERE token_hash=#{tokenHash}
SELECT * FROM t_oauth_tokens WHERE token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND token_type=#{type} AND revoked=0
SELECT id,parent_id,token_type,user_id FROM t_oauth_tokens WHERE token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND client_id=#{clientId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_oauth_tokens SET revoked=1 WHERE id=#{id} OR parent_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT t.client_id,t.user_id,t.scope,t.expires_at,t.revoked,COALESCE(c.resource,c.name) AS audience FROM t_oauth_tokens t JOIN t_oauth_clients c ON c.client_id=t.client_id JOIN t_platforms p ON p.id=c.platform_id AND p.is_deleted=0 WHERE t.token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND c.status='ACTIVE' AND c.is_deleted=0
SELECT k.id,k.user_id,k.audience FROM t_user_api_keys k JOIN t_users u ON u.id=k.user_id WHERE k.key_hash=#{keyHash} AND k.status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='active' AND u.is_active=1 AND u.is_deleted=0
SELECT id,name,audience,key_hash FROM t_user_api_keys WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_api_keys SET key_hash=#{keyHash},key_prefix=#{prefix},rotated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND key_hash=#{oldHash}
UPDATE t_user_api_keys SET last_used_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE' AND (last_used_at IS NULL OR last_used_at<DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 1 MINUTE))
mapper.select: SELECT c.client_id,c.client_secret_hash,c.client_type,c.client_kind,c.resource,c.name,c.redirect_uris,c.scopes,c.status,c.can_introspect_api_keys,c.skip_consent,c.platform_id,p.name AS platform_name FROM t_oauth_clients c JOIN t_platforms p ON p.id=c.platform_id AND p.is_deleted=0 WHERE c.client_id=#{clientId} AND c.is_deleted=0

SELECT t.user_id,t.client_id,t.scope,t.expires_at,t.revoked,COALESCE(c.resource,c.name) AS audience FROM t_oauth_tokens t JOIN t_oauth_clients c ON c.client_id=t.client_id JOIN t_platforms p ON p.id=c.platform_id AND p.is_deleted=0 WHERE t.token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND t.token_type='ACCESS' AND c.status='ACTIVE' AND c.is_deleted=0
